questions.question: Disease or unfortunate injuries can manipulate people’s brains in ways that would be unethical for experimental manipulations to do. But neuropsychological studies of these brains are not unethical and, as combined with current advances in neuroimagery, have the following advantage(s) over other techniques for gaining knowledge about the human brain. They
options: Are replicable
Allow for more detailed analysis of symptoms and for the coordination of these with how much tissue damage is present and where
Can vary the activity of the brain
Can experimentally control precisely the area of the brain that is damaged,
questions.reference_answer:
神經心理學研究 (neuropsychological studies)：
・這些研究利用自然發生的損傷或疾病，而不是實驗故意製造。
・結合神經影像技術，可以把行為症狀與受損區域做對應。

❌(A) 可重複性 → 損傷是自然發生，無法完全「複製」
✅ (B) 可以詳細分析症狀，並將其與受損範圍和位置對應 → 正確
❌(C) 改變大腦活動 → 這是TMS或電刺激的功能，不是損傷研究
❌(D) 精確控制損傷位置 → 無法控制，因為損傷不是人為製造
concepts: 神經心理學（Neuropsychology） 與腦部影像技術的應用

options: Matching paint colors
Recognizing faces
Remembering the words of a poem
Drawing the floor plan of a familiar house
All of the above

✅ (C) Remembering the words of a poem → 語言記憶（左半球）
❌(D) Drawing floor plan → 視空間（右半球）

questions.question: If, under certain circumstances, a participant’s hit rate went up in saying “yes” when he detected a signal while his false alarm rate stayed the same, we could conclude that his
options: Response criterion
Signal threshold
Sensitivity
Decision level
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:
如果：
• Hit rate 上升（更常正確地偵測到訊號）
• False alarm rate 不變（並沒有更多誤判）那表示：他真正提升了分辨訊號與雜訊的能力，也就是：
Sensitivity（感受性/敏感性）提高了。

questions.question: One aspect of sensory coding, the psychological intensity with which a stimulus is experienced, involves
options: The total number of neurons that are firing
The rate of neurotransmitter reuptake
The type of neurotransmitter released
The rate of action potentials fired
The direction of the action potential
questions.reference_answer:
心理強度指：
 👉 刺激看起來或感覺起來更強烈。
有兩種關鍵機制：
 ✅ 更多神經元同時活化（population coding）
 ✅ 神經元的放電速率更高（frequency coding）
所以：
 ✅(A) 總活化神經元數 ✔️ 這會影響強度
 ✅(D) 動作電位發放速率 ✔️ 這同樣決定強度

Perception of the elementary features of the object

questions.question: The way we interpret an object depends on ____
options: What features are present to be potentially identified
Which of these features and the selection and arrangement choices to which they guide us actually trigger identifications
Both bottom-up (fine-grained) and top-down (large-scale) analyses of these identifications
a, b, and c
questions.reference_answer:
知覺解釋的多層次理論：
我們如何解讀一個物體，會同時依賴：
✅(a) 物體本身有什麼特徵（底層輸入）
✅(b) 這些特徵的組合和選擇如何觸發辨認（模式匹配）
✅(c) 自下而上分析與自上而下分析的結合（整合兩種處理）

questions.question: It appears that there is a ＿＿＿＿ relationship between the time to scan a mental image from one point to another and the time to scan between the same points on the actual picture of which the image is an analog.
options: Symbolic
Representational
Haphazard
Proportional

questions.reference_answer:

心像掃描的時間和實際圖片上距離成比例。
換句話說：
・距離越長 → 掃描時間越長
・兩者有線性比例關係

questions.question: What is the adaptive significance of habituation?
options: It greatly intensifies the effects of sensitization
It allows organisms to ignore familiar but harmless stimuli otherwise difficult not to react to
It paves the way for associative conditioning
It keeps neurons active when they might otherwise regenerate
questions.reference_answer:
✅ 習慣化 (habituation)
 = 對重複出現、無害的刺激反應逐漸減弱。演化功能：
 ➡️ 幫助生物忽略熟悉但無害的刺激，以便專注在更重要的新事件上。
❌(A) 增強敏感化 → 不是習慣化的功能
✅ (B) 忽略熟悉但無害的刺激 → 正確
❌(C) 為聯結制約鋪路 → 不是主要功能
❌(D) 維持神經元活性 → 不是習慣化的作用
concepts: Habituation（習慣化）的功能與演化意義

questions.question: In a classical conditioning experiment in which a tone is paired with meat in the mouth, a dog comes to salivate to the sound of the tone. The tone is called the
options: Conditioned stimulus
Unconditioned stimulus
Unconditioned response
Stimulus generalization
Reinforcer
questions.reference_answer:
古典制約 (classical conditioning) 經典範例：
・肉（放在嘴裡）= 無條件刺激（unconditioned stimulus, UCS）
・唾液分泌對肉的反應 = 無條件反應（unconditioned response, UCR）
・聲音（先中性，經配對後引發唾液）= 條件刺激（conditioned stimulus, CS）
・對聲音分泌唾液 = 條件反應（conditioned response, CR）

We learn better when under pressure
Extinction does not erase original learning

questions.reference_answer:
再制約 (reconditioning)：
經歷滅除後，再次配對CS和US，學習會恢復得更快。
這證明：
👉 滅除並沒有抹去原本的學習記憶，只是暫時抑制了它。

questions.question: According to the law of effect, responses followed by reward
options: Decrease in frequency
Are not always reinforced
Become trials or errors
Are strengthened
all of the above
questions.reference_answer:
效果律（Law of Effect）由 Edward Thorndike 提出，核心觀點：
✅ 行為如果伴隨令人滿意的結果（獎勵），該行為以後會更常出現，也就是被強化。

❌ a. 減少頻率
❌ b. 有時不被強化
❌ c. 成為試誤（試誤是學習過程，不是結果）
✅ d. 被強化 ✔️

questions.question: Operant conditioning differs from classical conditioning in that
options: In operant conditioning, the response is voluntary, whereas in classical conditioning, the response is elicited by the US
Associations are formed only in classical conditioning, not in operant conditioning
Responses are never involved in classical conditioning as they are in operant conditioning
Operant conditioning always occurs gradually, in trial-and-error fashion, whereas classical conditioning
Occurs very rapidly
questions.reference_answer:
操作制約：
• 自發性反應（自願行為）
• 行為由後果來強化或削弱
古典制約：
• 反射性反應（不自主）
• 行為是由無條件刺激（US）觸發

✅ (a) 操作制約是自願反應，古典制約是由US引發反射性反應。→ 正確
❌(b) 誤導，兩者都建立聯結
❌(c) 錯，古典制約也有反應（唾液分泌等）
❌(d) 不正確，古典制約也可能逐漸建立，操作制約不一定是慢慢 trial-and-error
❌(e) 錯，兩者學習速率都可以快或慢

questions.reference_answer:
記憶的三個主要階段：
1️⃣ 編碼 (Acquisition / Encoding) → 先把訊息獲取進記憶系統
2️⃣ 儲存 (Storage)
3️⃣ 提取 (Recall / Retrieval)

要記住任何事情，第一步就是先取得/編碼它。

questions.question: According to the stage theory
options: Items enter memory in pieces rather than as whole
Items must pass through working memory to get into long-term memory
All items that get into working memory are eventually transferred to long-term memory
Both b and c
questions.reference_answer:
Stage theory = Atkinson & Shiffrin 多重記憶階段模型（multi-store model）。
流程：sensory memory → working/short-term memory → long-term memory。

✔ B：資訊須先進入 short-term/working memory，才有機會進入 long-term memory。

❌ A：不是 stage theory 的核心敘述。
❌ C：並非所有進入 working memory 的資訊都會進入 long-term memory；大部分會消失，只有經過 rehearsal（複誦）、elaboration（精緻化）、meaningful encoding（有意義編碼）的資訊才比較容易長期保存。
❌ D：B + C 組合，因 C 錯故 D 也錯。
concepts:
Atkinson & Shiffrin  （1968）
記憶階段理論（Stage Theory）中的多重儲存模型（Multi-store Model）

questions.question: Memory consolidation refers to the biological process that takes place for a period of time after an event is experienced. This process ____
options: Transforms all information intro  memory traces
Transfers items in short-term memory to long-term memory
Removes fragile and transient memory traces from those that are more robust
Transforms memories from fragile and transient status to more permanent and robust state
questions.reference_answer:
記憶鞏固 (memory consolidation)：
✅ 核心概念：
 記憶剛形成時很脆弱，需要時間進行生物過程（如突觸改變、基因表達），把暫時的記憶變成持久的記憶。

❌(a) 將所有資訊轉為痕跡 → 太廣泛，不正確
❌(b) 將短期記憶直接轉為長期 → 不完整，因為鞏固也涉及質的改變，不只是「轉移」
❌(c) 移除脆弱記憶 → 錯誤，重點是強化，不是移除
✅ (d) 把脆弱、短暫的記憶轉變為更穩定的長期記憶 → 完全正確

questions.question: Tomasello supports the Interactionist view on language acquisition in humans. What does this view propose?
options: Children have to be able to interact with children of the same age from young to be able to acquire language
Children's biologically programmed ability to speak must be complemented with extensive experience with language
Children's biologically programmed ability to speak must be complimented with their ability to gesture
Children must interact with more knowledgeable others and to engage in a variety of social interactions
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:

・語言能力部分是生物天賦（biologically programmed）
・同時也需要大量的社會經驗和語言互動來啟動和豐富這種能力

換句話說：
✅ 生物本能 + 與他人的語言經驗 → 語言發展

(d) Vygotsky 式強調「與更有知識者互動」→ 這是社會文化論，和 Tomasello 的重點不完全一樣

questions.question: In the case of maltreated children like Genie, the general finding is that children who have never been spoken to from birth up till puberty can never reach the language proficiency typical for their age. As such, the Critical Period Hypothesis states that
options: Our biologically programmed ability to speak must be complemented with interactive language experience in early childhood
Our biologically programmed ability to speak must be complemented with interactive language experience in the first year of life
Our biologically programmed ability to speak must be activated with hearing speech in early childhood
Our biologically programmed ability lasts for only a few years from birth before it disappears
questions.reference_answer:
語言的關鍵期假說 (Critical Period Hypothesis)：
✅ 核心觀點：語言習得需要在童年早期（特別是在青春期前）接觸語言，否則很難完全掌握。
Genie的案例支持：
・生理上具備語言能力
・但若缺乏早期互動性語言經驗，就無法達到年齡應有的語言水平
concepts: Lenneberg（1967）語言的關鍵期假說 Critical Period Hypothesis（CPH）

questions.question: In explaining why our behaviors are motivated, the urge to reduce a drive has been described through the Drive-Behaviors- Equilibrium process. These components are defined as ____

State of internal bodily tension - Behavior that serves to reduce the drive - Drive reduction is achieved
State of internal bodily tension - Behavior that serves to reduce the drive - Internal bodily tension is partially transformed external bodily tension
partially transformed external bodily tension
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:
動機驅力理論 (Drive Reduction Theory)：三個核心部分：
 ✅ 內在身體緊張狀態 (internal bodily tension)（如飢餓、口渴）
 → 驅動行為去降低這種緊張
 → 驅力減弱，恢復平衡（equilibrium）

questions.question: A Causal Attribution is...
options: A step of associating two phenomena, one behavioral one situational
A step of producing an outcome for a cause
A step of inferring or concluding what the cause of an observation was
A step of inferring what an observation based on a known cause
questions.reference_answer:
Causal Attribution（因果歸因）是：
✅ 當你觀察到一個行為或事件時，推斷它的原因是什麼。
❌(a) 只是把兩個現象聯結起來 → 不夠精確❌(b) 從因產生結果 → 不是歸因，是因果過程
✅ (c) 根據觀察，推斷原因 → 完全正確
❌(d) 根據已知原因推斷觀察 → 方向顛倒
concepts: 歸因理論（Attribution Theory）中的因果歸因（Causal Attribution）

questions.question: The Fundamental Attribution error refers to the
options: Tendency to attribute behaviors to dispositional qualities while underrating the role of the situation
Tendency to attribute behaviors to the situational qualities while underrating the role of person disposition
Tendency to underrate both dispositional and situational factors in making attributions about behavior
Tendency to attribute behaviors to the culture while underrating the role of the person and community
questions.reference_answer:
Fundamental Attribution Error（基本歸因謬誤）指：
👉 當我們解釋他人行為時，傾向過度歸因於他們的性格特質（內在因素），而低估情境的影響。
✅ (a) 把行為歸因於性格（內在），低估情境 → 完全正確
❌(b) 剛好相反 → 錯
❌(c) 低估兩者 → 錯
❌(d) 歸因於文化 → 不正確

questions.question: In one of the earliest studies on conformity, Sherif (1937) used an autokinetic effect (a seemingly moving spot of light) to demonstrate conformity. He found that
options: When participants viewed a light alone, their responses varied; when they viewed the light with others, their responses usually conformed to the most recent participant
When participants viewed a light alone, their responses varied; when they viewed the light with others, their responses usually conformed to the norm that developed in their particular group
When participants viewed a light alone, their responses varied; when they viewed the light with others, their esponses usually conformed to whoever who seemed more knowledgeable
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:
Sherif (1937) 的自動運動效應 (autokinetic effect) 實驗：
✅ 一個靜止的光點在黑暗中看起來會動，實際上沒在動。
✅ 參與者單獨時，估計距離差異很大（沒標準）。
✅ 小組討論後，慢慢形成一致的「群體標準」，之後個體的回答會趨於這個群體規範。
concepts:

questions.question: What is risky shift?
options: Patten in which a group appears to be more willing to take chances, or more willing to take an extreme stance, than the individual group members would have been on their own
Pattem in which a group risks losing the ability to make a decision even though they were close to making a decision
Pattern in which a group appears to be less willing to take chances than the individual group members would have been on their own
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:
✅ 這是團體決策的一種現象：
當人們在小組裡討論時，會比單獨決策時傾向採取更大風險。（即小組決策往往更冒險）
✅ Risky Shift 是 Group Polarization 的一種形式，特指討論後團體決策變得更冒險。

questions.question: Depth perception in babies has been tested using the Visual Cliff experiment which tells us that:
options: Babies between 6 and 14 months of age would not cross the fake cliff even with encouragement
Babies between 6 and 14 months of age would cross the fake cliff with their mothers' encouragement
Babies between 6 and 14 months of age would cross the fake cliff, but very slowly
Babies between 6 and 14 months of age would cross the fake cliff, but without ever looking down
questions.reference_answer:
視覺懸崖實驗（Visual Cliff Experiment）：✅ 結果顯示：
・6-14個月大的嬰兒已經具備深度知覺
・即使媽媽在對面鼓勵，大多數嬰兒不會爬過假懸崖
・他們通常會停在玻璃邊緣，顯示出猶豫或恐懼

questions.question: According to Piaget’s theory of cognitive development, children in the pre-operational stage have a problem of centration, as demonstrated using a conservation task. That is, children focus their attention on only one dimension or characteristic of an object or situation. The following are examples except
options: Children might judge a container as having more liquid because it's a taller container than the other, even though both containers have the same amount

Children might judge a row of counters as having more because it has been spaced apart more than the other row (the counters being close together), even though both rows have the same number of counters
Children might judge a container as having more liquid because its a wider container than the other, even though both containers have the same amount
Children might judge a row of counters has having more because the counters are bigger than the other w, even though both rows have the same number of counters. e, a and b
a and b
c and d
questions.reference_answer:
皮亞傑「集中化 (centration)」的概念：

✅ 集中化：
幼兒在前運思期（2–7歲）只關注物體的一個面向，忽略其他相關特徵，因此守恆任務 (conservation tasks) 失敗。
集中化是注意力只看一個面向，守恆是理解雖然外觀改變，但量仍不變的概念，結果，是孩子在前運思期無法理解量不變性，所以集中化導致守恆失敗。
concepts: Piaget 認知發展理論（Piaget's Theory of Cognitive Development－Assimilation）集中化（centration）與守恆概念（conservation）

questions.question: Caregiver-child attachment is the strong emotional bond that forms in the second half of the Ist year between infants and their primary caregiver. The following behaviors that are visible signs of attachment except
options: Active efforts to make contact
Warm greetings
Audible verbalizations
Proximity in unfamiliar situations
questions.reference_answer:
依附行為 (attachment behaviors) 在嬰兒與主要照顧者之間的表現：
・接近與保持接觸 (proximity seeking)
・主動嘗試接觸 (active efforts to make contact)
・在陌生情境中尋求安全 (proximity in unfamiliar situations)
・當見到照顧者時表現愉快 (warm greetings)

questions.question: Mischel (1968) proposed the Personality Paradox to explain that people behave much less consistently than their personality traits would predict. Evidence for this comes from:
options: Low correlations between measures of traits taken at different times at the same place
Low correlations between measures of traits taken in different situations
Low correlations between measures of traits taken in different countries
None of the above
questions.reference_answer:
Walter Mischel（1968）批評人格特質論：行為的跨情境一致性遠低於特質論預測，此即 Personality Paradox（人格悖論）。

研究發現：不同情境下的行為相關通常不高。
例：在家外向、在學校安靜、在陌生人前害羞 → traits 對行為的預測力有限。

此發現後來促成 interactionism（人格 × 情境交互作用觀點）的發展。
→ ✔ B 正確。
concepts: Walter Mischel（1968）提出的「人格悖論（Personality Paradox）
questions.key_concepts: Walter Mischel（1968）提出的「人格悖論（Personality Paradox）
questions.ai_hint: Mischel 1968：Personality Paradox，行為跨情境一致性低，特質預測力有限，促成 person × situation interactionism。答案 B。
